boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel/lodging searches where room-level amenities are relevant; do not apply this default to flights, car rentals, destinations, dates, party size, or other non-hotel constraints.
condition: When the synthetic user is searching for hotel lodging and room amenities are being filtered or compared, treat an in-room fireplace as a preferred comfort amenity.
default_action: Prioritize or recommend otherwise suitable hotel rooms that explicitly list a fireplace.
exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable hotel room with a fireplace is available, or if the user explicitly prioritizes different required constraints that conflict with it, surface the tradeoff and ask whether to relax the fireplace preference.
name: Prefer hotel rooms that include a fireplace
rationale: Three independent scripted hotel-search sources request a fireplace as a desired room amenity. The shared support is for a reusable hotel-room amenity preference, not for the one-off dates, party sizes, ski-area setting, balcony, or other amenities mentioned in individual requests.

source_evidence.contribution: The user asks whether the room has several amenities, including "a fireplace."
The user says they are looking for a room with "a great balcony" and "nice fireplace," supporting fireplace as a desired hotel-room feature.
The user requests a place where "the room has a fireplace," grounding the same amenity preference in a separate instruction source.
